id: Tempel tanda tangan, gambar, atau teks di halaman lewat alat Tempel di pratinjau. Foto tanda tangan di kertas langsung bisa dipakai: latar kertasnya dibuang.
Isi formulir PDF lewat menu ··· > Isi formulir: kolom teks, centang, dan pilihan. Saat disimpan, isiannya jadi bagian halaman.
Pisah PDF per rentang halaman, misalnya 1-3, 4-10, 11.
PDF/A dari Lembar lolos pemeriksaan veraPDF dalam uji kami, termasuk yang berisi formulir dan tanda tangan.
en: Place a signature, image, or text on a page with the Place tool in the preview. A photo of a signature on paper works as is: the paper background is removed.
Fill in PDF forms from the ··· menu > Fill in form: text fields, checkboxes, and choices. When saved, the entries become part of the page.
Split a PDF by page ranges, such as 1-3, 4-10, 11.
PDF/A from Lembar passes veraPDF in our tests, including files with forms and signatures.
